Name: Simple Sounds
Author: BleakCodex
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Note: This is a Modding Resource, while possibly required by other Content Packs, it does not have an effect by itself.[/size]

[size=6]
[b]Simple Sounds[/b][/size]
[/font]

[b][size=5]Installation[/size]
[/b]Extract ZIP to your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory


[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]
[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI


[/url][b][size=5]What is [i]Simple Sounds[/i]?[/size][/b]

Simple Sounds is a SMAPI Modding Resource which allows the import of Sound Files for use in Events or other Mods.
Namely, this allows Sounds to be imported via a Content Pack and then referenced in events when using [i][b]/playSound {sound}[/b][/i]


[b]
[size=5]How do I use [i][b][size=5][i]Simple Sounds[/i][/size][/b]? [/i][/size]
[/b]For Mod Authors, usage is similar to other SMAPI Content Packs:


[size=4][b]1.) Create a manifest.json[/b][/size]
Follow the[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Modder_Guide/APIs/Manifest] SMAPI Manifest Format
[/url]You will need a [i]ContentPackFor [/i]entry pointed to SimpleSounds:﻿
[code]"ContentPackFor": {
"UniqueID": "BleakCodex.SimpleSounds"
},
[/code]

[size=4][b]2.) Create a content.json
[/b][/size]The format is as follows:

[code]{
"Sounds" : [
{
  "Name": "{REQUIRED}",
  "FromFile": "{REQUIRED}",
  "Loop": {OPTIONAL - DEFAULT "false"},
  "InstanceLimit" : {OPTIONAL - Default "1"},
  "LimitBehavior" : {OPTIONAL - Default "FailToPlay" - {FailToPlay | ReplaceOldest} }
},
       ...
]
}[/code]
[list]
[*]Name
[/list] ﻿﻿The Name of the sound that will be added to the SDV Soundbank. Can be referenced during events via[i] /playSound {Name}[/i]
[list]
[*]FromFile
[/list] ﻿﻿The directory and fileName of the sound you're adding. SDV supports .WAV files, so other formats will need to be converted.
[list]
[*]Loop
[/list] ﻿ ﻿If the sound should be looped until stopped.
[list]
[*]InstanceLimit
[/list] ﻿ ﻿How many instances of this sound can be playing at once, 0 = Unlimited
[list]
[*]LimitBehavior
[/list] ﻿ ﻿Can either be {FailToPlay | ReplaceOldest} - if an instance limit is specified, once the limit is hit will determine if the oldest instance should stop, or if ﻿ ﻿the newest instance should not play}


[size=4][b]3.) Include your .WAV files and copy your Content Pack into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder


Done!
[/b][/size]Once complete this sound will be accessible from the in-build SDV Soundbank, meaning you'll have access to it in events with:
[code]/playSound {Name}[/code]
Or via other mods which leverage the Stardew Valley Soundbank.



[size=4][b]Feature Requests[/b][/size]
There are other mods which allow the replacement of sounds so I would recommend them over this one if that is your need.
It's likely possible to add music as well if there is a use-case and another mod hasn't already solved that.
Otherwise I will probably aim to keep this mod simple in order to keep maintainability low and compatibility high.
